The owner needs offline editing and portable Markdown export. The monthly budget ceiling is 120 credits.

# orion-quote.md

Vendor quote for this trimester: Orion costs 140 credits per month. Orion offers offline editing and Markdown export.

Vendor catalog for the same trimester: Orion costs 110 credits per month. This conflicts with the quote. No source establishes which price is current.

Vega costs 90 credits per month. Vega exports Markdown but requires an internet connection for editing. No source supplies migration duration.

# Source review

## Source statement

The monthly budget ceiling is 120 credits.

Limits: From requirements.md, this is the owner's constraint for all options.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)

## Source statement

Orion costs 140 credits per month according to the vendor quote.

Limits: This price exceeds the budget ceiling by 20 credits and cannot be afforded under current constraints.

[orion-quote.md](orion-quote.md)

## Source statement

Orion costs 110 credits per month according to the vendor catalog.

Limits: This conflicts with the quote in E2; no source establishes which price is current. This price would fit within budget (40 credits under).

[orion-catalog.md](orion-catalog.md)

## Source statement

Vega costs 90 credits per month according to the vendor catalog.

Limits: This price fits comfortably within budget (30 credits under). However, it has limitations compared to Orion.

[vega-catalog.md](vega-catalog.md)

## Inference / recommendation

Orion offers offline editing and portable Markdown export, which matches the owner's requirements.

Limits: From orion-quote.md (E2), Orion offers offline editing and Markdown export. The catalog (E3) does not contradict these features; only the price differs.

[orion-quote.md](orion-quote.md)

[orion-catalog.md](orion-catalog.md)

## Source statement

Vega exports Markdown but requires an internet connection for editing, which conflicts with the owner's need for offline editing.

Limits: This limitation makes Vega unsuitable if offline editing is required.

[vega-catalog.md](vega-catalog.md)

## Inference / recommendation

The two conflicting Orion prices (140 credits in the quote and 110 credits in the catalog) are unresolved; I do not attempt to determine which is current.

Limits: E3 explicitly states: "No source establishes which price is current." The conflict must be retained without resolution per requirements.

No source passage attached. This inference is unsupported and needs review.

## Source statement

Migration duration is unknown because no source supplies this information.

Limits: orion-catalog.md (E3) and the other sources do not provide migration duration. E4 notes: "No source supplies migration duration."
